name: Water
changes: Daily water ring, one-tap glasses, a week chart and reminders through the day
description: Tap a glass, fill the ring. A week chart and gentle reminders through the day, all on this phone.
schema: CREATE TABLE intake (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), ml INTEGER NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now', 'localtime')), at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (time('now', 'localtime')))
CREATE TABLE settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, goal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2500, start TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:00', gap INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, times INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6)

card.query: SELECT ml, goal, CAST(round(100.0 * ml / goal) AS INTEGER) AS pct, CASE WHEN ml >= goal THEN 'Goal reached 💧' ELSE '**' || (goal - ml) || ' ml** to go today' END AS headline FROM (SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(ml), 0) FROM intake WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime')) AS ml, (SELECT goal FROM settings WHERE id = 1) AS goal)
card.chart: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT coalesce((SELECT sum(ml) FROM intake WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')), 0) FROM d

widget.query: SELECT ml, goal, round(min(1.0, 1.0 * ml / goal), 2) AS ratio FROM (SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(ml), 0) FROM intake WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime')) AS ml, (SELECT goal FROM settings WHERE id = 1) AS goal)
